Completion prose is useful as a lead for provenance recovery but must be classified as an unverified claim source until linked to a repository object or retained private source.
proposed: Represent every recovered memory source with source_class, immutability, coverage, privacy, and verification_status fields.
Classify automation completion prose as source_class=run_report, immutability=unproven, verification_status=lead_only unless a commit, blob, artifact, or retained source is independently resolved.
Do not reuse M-004, M-005, or M-006 identifiers for reconstructed artifacts; preserve them as provenance gaps.
superseded: Treating a detailed completion report as proof that its named files and commits exist.
Treating an empty repository code-search response as exhaustive absence evidence.
Repairing continuity by silently recreating a reported artifact under the same identifier.
unresolved: The originating private or historical source that first assigned M-004, M-005, and M-006.
Whether any authentic pre-reconciliation repository objects for those identifiers exist outside currently observed history coverage.

memory_recovered.title: Claim-source separation
memory_recovered.durable_rule: A run report is a provenance lead, not project truth. Persisted memory becomes authoritative only when its source object, coverage envelope, privacy boundary, and verification status are recorded.
memory_recovered.operational_effect: Continuity mining can use prior prose to search, but cannot promote the prose's claims into canonical history without independent evidence.

coverage_limit: Default-branch canonical files, recent indexed commits, selected immutable reconciliation evidence, repository code search, and one identifier-specific commit search were inspected. Exhaustive branch inventory, exhaustive commit traversal, private chat-history retrieval, and full file-library provenance were not available in this run.
privacy_boundary: Only repository metadata, operational identifiers, and abstract provenance rules are persisted. No private chat passages, health information, personal identifiers, credentials, or sensitive project content are reproduced.
falsification_route: Produce an authentic immutable source object predating this audit that contains M-004, M-005, or M-006. Link the object, preserve this bounded observation, and revise the affected claim from unresolved to observed with the newly established coverage.
